Sanity checks on the deposit: the stored composite 'anomi' equals the unreversed mean of anomi_1..7 on 308/309 rows (the one exception is a partial-missing row where anomi = sum/7), consistent with no reverse-keyed items; Cronbach alpha 0.859 on complete cases vs the paper's 0.85; min inter-item r 0.32; the paper's quoted example item ('My whole world feels like it's falling apart') is the anomi_3 label. The label's shared prefix 'Please state how much you agree or disagree with these questions. - ' (Qualtrics matrix stem, identical across several blocks) was split off into instructions, trailing ' - ' removed; stems otherwise verbatim. No value labels exist in the file, so option text comes from the paper: only 1, 4, 7 are labelled; 2,3,5,6 ship blank, not padded. Per-item: every item used all 7 levels in the live data (irw_table_sets per_item), and each item carries rows for 1..7. Whether the English labels are Travis's original English or the study's back-translation is not stated; the paper says item wordings are given 'forward-back translated into English'. Anchors likewise are the paper's English. RIGHTS: silence. Paper and deposit CC BY 4.0. Originator Travis (1993), a Springer journal article; no fee, permission, NC, ND or no-redistribution clause located (searched; scales.arabpsychology.com's Travis page states none).
